overview: Deterministic E2E validation for row decision flows in a drawer-first review surface, including mutation feedback and copy behavior.
goals: Ensure mutation outcomes are explicit and immediate.
Catch silent failures in row decision workflows.
successMetrics: Decision actions update row status deterministically.
Mutation failure path always renders deterministic error UX.
uiNotes: Drawer must preserve row context while actioning decisions.
`mark reviewed`, `flag issue`, and `copy extracted answer` are mandatory controls.
Mutation errors must render shared error contract.

importFormat.description: No import; scenario uses seeded rows requiring review decisions.

rules: Decision mutations must be explicit and auditable.
Clipboard action must show user-visible result.

stories.title: Execute Row Decisions from Drawer
stories.description: As a reviewer, I use one decision surface to mark reviewed, flag issues, and copy extracted answers with immediate feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a row in `needs_review`, opening row details reveals decision controls in drawer context.
When `mark reviewed` or `flag issue` is executed, row status updates in UI without hidden state transitions.
Then copy action places extracted answer in clipboard and surfaces confirmation.
Example: `mark reviewed` updates status chip from `needs_review` to `reviewed` immediately.
Negative: mutation API error renders deterministic `ErrorBanner` and row status does not falsely update.
